heading: Building a temporal value from its fields
text:
## Building a temporal value from its fields [LTIM.14]

DS reads no temporal text: no cast and no member makes a `Time`, a `Date` or a
`Duration` from a `String` ([LCST.4.5.2]). A host or an adapter delivers a
temporal value already typed ([LADP.4.2.1], [LTIM.11.2]), and a rule builds one
from integer fields with the `calendar` module ([LIMP.3.3.4]). A `Duration` is
built by unit arithmetic ([LTIM.4.1.1]): `h * 1_h + m * 1_min`.
